Title: Azure Cache for Redis: Redis 6.0 supported in general availability

Body.Content:
Now supported in Azure Cache for Redis, Redis 6.0 includes a new feature and a set of smaller performance enhancements, boosts security, and developer productivity features. You can now use an append-only data structure, Redis Streams, to ingest, manage, and make sense of data that is continuously being generated. Additionally, Redis 6.0 introduces new commands such as STRALGO, ZPOPMIN, ZPOPMAX, and HELP for performance and ease of use.

Get started with Redis 6.0 today and select either Redis 6.0 during cache creation or upgrade your existing Redis 4.0 cache instances.
